historySemantics.PassFeedback0: previous response-pass state at the same source coordinate
historySemantics.integrationClock: one complete physical update per presented normal-forward N=1 frame

safety.shaderSubframes: TotalSubFrames other than 1 bypasses temporal integration and outputs the static current physical target with neutral ionic state.
safety.rewind: disabled because backwards emulator time cannot reconstruct the prior physical feedback texture
safety.runAhead: disabled because speculative or discarded frames are outside the submitted-frame history contract
safety.fastForward: fixed to 1x because dropped or unpaced frames do not represent the reference frame period
safety.frameMixing: disabled because Gambatte blending would apply a second temporal model before the physical reconstruction
safety.saveStateLoad: supported as a causal abrupt source-image transition; the physical panel state remains continuous and settles toward the loaded content
safety.pauseResume: supported with a frozen physical clock; wall-clock relaxation during pause is not modeled
safety.resetAndReload: a newly cleared feedback surface initializes directly to the current static physical target with neutral ionic state

claimBoundary: This contract reproduces panel evolution under the frames actually submitted by a normal-forward frontend. It does not reconstruct hidden emulator frames or real-time relaxation while presentation is stopped.
